executive_positioning.goal: Help the owner see that High Country has a strong regional outdoor retail ecommerce foundation and a focused opportunity to make it easier for customers to find and buy products.
executive_positioning.outreach_readiness: Stronger than a raw grade sheet, because it leads with business relevance, respects what already works, and moves experiment detail to references.
executive_positioning.reply_likelihood: Higher if sent as a concise executive readout with a specific offer to validate customer effort and buying friction using High Country internal ecommerce metrics, not as a long technical audit.

search.readout: High Country shows a strong online product-finding foundation among comparable regional outdoor retailers.

autocomplete.readout: Comparable regional retailers show different early-journey guidance patterns, and the useful opportunity is improving consistency across the customer shopping journey.

opportunity_model.basis: Directional model from public experiments only. Dollar impact requires site-search usage, conversion rate, AOV, revenue, and analytics segmentation.
opportunity_model.rationale: Search and browse already recover many intents. The main upside is earlier assistance and consistency: fewer shoppers should have to press enter, reformulate, or know exact English catalog language.

competitor_evidence.purpose: Clarify the earlier competitor limitation and add a bounded opportunity story around national outdoor retailers and organic versus sponsored/retail-media visibility.
